name: automatic-refinement
instructions:
Run a bounded multi-agent refinement graph after grill-with-docs. Route canonical skills from the context and objective, enforce typed handoffs and bounded iteration, and stop at refined-awaiting-review without publishing or implementing.

Capabilities:
- plan and execute a dynamic multi-agent refinement graph
- agents invoke canonical skills they need based on context and objective
- route skills dynamically through canonical graph/graph-skill-routing, with no fixed role set
- enforce typed handoffs, budgets, convergence, and independent verification via canonical loop/loop-engineering
- synthesize a review-ready RefinementArtifact without remote effects

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/routing/automatic-refinement/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Loop-engineering reports converged, budget-exceeded, no-progress, or ping-pong; all agent skill invocations have valid typed handoffs; a RefinementArtifact is emitted at refined-awaiting-review or a typed terminal failure is returned.
